evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 6, printed p. 1229, Results B, activated luminescence and quantum-yield estimate

measurements.conditions: All three activated colloids: initial-absorbance correction and integrated emission compared with dilute R6G in ethanol (reference QY 0.9). No physical batch or fraction joins resolved. pH above about 5 quenches room-temperature emission; second acidic reflux can partly restore it, while prolonged strong-base exposure can prevent recovery. Base identity, exposure duration and titration protocol not reported.
